topic: Korea's suneung exam ticket (수험표) works as a discount card for about six weeks after the exam. 2027 CSAT held 2026-11-19, 551,864 applicants (KICE, 2026-09-08). Everland full-day pass ₩20,000 for students to year end, up to 3 companions ₩30,000; Lotte World Seoul ₩27,000, Busan ₩20,000 to 12/31; Seoul Land ₩20,500 vs regular ₩52,000 (MyDaily 11-20, Etoday 11-19, Daily Hankook 11-15). T'way and Eastar domestic 25% off for student + 1 companion, Jeju Air domestic 20% (Etoday). Korail Tourism Network rail tours 20% off to 12/31. Cinemas ₩7,000 tickets. Musical Sweeney Todd 30%. Kensington Yeouido buffet 50% (1 student per table), 63 restaurants 40%, Jeju Shilla buffet 30%. Hi-mart: exam ticket holders get storage upgrade or AirPods 4 with phone purchase; telecoms give coupons to people born 2006-2008. Bonjuk says suneung week sales rose 33% last year. Proof: original ticket + ID; photos/copies often refused. No other-country comparison.
title: In Korea, the Exam Ticket Becomes a Discount Card

slides.headline: In Korea, the exam ticket becomes **a discount card.**
slides.note: Students are told not to throw it away.

slides.headline: One small card, **many doors**
slides.body: Korea's college entrance exam was held on November 19. Each student got an exam ticket with their photo and seat number. For the next six weeks, that ticket plus an ID opens discounts across the country.

slides.headline: Theme parks for about **₩20,000**
slides.body: Everland sells students a full-day pass for ₩20,000 until the end of the year. Lotte World Seoul charges ₩27,000. Seoul Land drops its ₩52,000 pass to ₩20,500.

slides.headline: Flights **25% off**
slides.body: Budget airlines T'way and Eastar Jet cut domestic fares by 25% for the student and one companion. Jeju Air gives 20%. Most deals run through the winter break.

slides.headline: Trains, movies, **musicals**
slides.body: Rail tour packages are 20% off until December 31. Movie tickets go down to ₩7,000. One big musical takes 30% off its best seats for students.

slides.headline: Hotel buffets at **half price**
slides.body: A hotel buffet in Seoul's Yeouido is 50% off for one student per table. Restaurants in the 63 Building take 40% off a set menu. A hotel buffet on Jeju gives 30%.

slides.headline: applied for **the exam**
slides.body: That many people signed up for this year's exam. Almost all of them are 18 or 19, and most will soon start college or their first job.

slides.headline: Even **phones**
slides.body: One electronics chain gives ticket holders a free storage upgrade or wireless earbuds when they buy a phone. Mobile carriers send coupons to everyone born from 2006 to 2008.

slides.headline: Why so **generous?**
slides.body: Brands want this new class of adults as customers. One porridge chain says its sales rose 33% in exam week last year. The rule is simple: bring the original ticket and an ID. Photos usually do not count.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, the college entrance exam ticket turns into a discount card the moment the test ends. Theme parks for about ₩20,000, flights 25% off, hotel buffets at half price.

The only rule: bring the original ticket and an ID.

Does your country reward students after a big exam?
reply: Why not just accept a photo of the ticket? Shops worry about copies being shared, so most ask for the original paper ticket plus an ID. Some also accept a university application receipt or an early-admission letter instead. Each brand sets its own dates, from a few days after the exam to the end of February.
fact_check: 2장: 2027학년도 수능 2026-11-19 시행 — 평가원 발표(머니투데이 2026-09-08). '6주'는 대부분 행사 11/19~12/31 기준 표현. 수험표+신분증 제시 — 마이데일리 11-20·이투데이 11-19.
3장: 에버랜드 수험생 종일권 2만 원(11/20~연말, 동반 3인 3만 원), 롯데월드 서울 2만7천 원·부산 2만 원(11/19~12/31), 서울랜드 정상가 5만2천 원→2만500원 — 마이데일리·이투데이·데일리한국 11-15.
4장: 티웨이(트리니티)·이스타 국내선 25%, 제주항공 국내선 FLEX 20%, 수험생+동반 1인, 탑승 기간 2~3월까지 — 이투데이 11-19.
5장: 코레일관광개발 기차여행 상품 20%(~12/31) — 마이데일리. 영화 7천 원(CGV·롯데·메가박스) — 이투데이. 뮤지컬 '스위니 토드' R·S·A석 30% — 이투데이.
6장: 켄싱턴호텔 여의도 브로드웨이 뷔페 50%(테이블당 수험생 1인), 63 레스토랑 지정 코스 40%, 제주신라 더파크뷰 디너 30% — 마이데일리·이투데이.
7장: 지원자 551,864명 — 평가원 응시원서 접수 결과 2026-09-08. '대부분 18~19세'는 고3 재학생·N수생 비중 고려한 표현이라 'almost all' 대신 완화 검토 가능.
8장: 롯데하이마트 '하이마트 수능 패스' 스마트폰 구매 조건 최대 31만 원 상당 저장공간 업그레이드 또는 에어팟4, KT 2006~2008년생 혜택, SKT 쿠폰 — 마이데일리.
9장: 본죽 지난해 수능 주간 매출 전주 대비 33% 증가 — 마이데일리. 원본 수험표+신분증, 사진·사본 불인정 많음 — 이투데이·블로그 종합.
reply: 수시 합격증·원서 접수증 대체 인정 — 서울랜드·제주항공 공지(이투데이). 종료일 범위: 11/22(샤브올데이)~2027-02 탑승분(항공).
